item.title: 4 dead after US refueling aircraft goes down in western Iraq
item.summary: Four U.S. military members have been killed when their refueling aircraft "went down" in friendly airspace in western Iraq, according to U.S. Central Command.

item.title: Suspect in Michigan synagogue attack lost family in Israeli strike on Lebanon: Mayor
item.summary: Dearborn Heights Mayor Mo Baydoun said Ayman Ghazali, 41, suspect in a Detroit-area synagogue shooting and ramming, lost relatives in an Israeli strike in Lebanon.
